article.title: Google Analytics加入Data Manager測試版，集中檢視資料連線
article.title_en: Google Analytics adds a Data Manager beta for data connections
article.summary: 管理介面新增入口，讓團隊管理資料串流、產品連結及第一方資料。
article.summary_en: The admin hub manages streams, product links and first-party data.
highlights: 可從同一入口查看診斷提示與連線狀況。
Google說明列明子資源及匯總資源目前不支援該首頁。
highlights_en: The hub surfaces diagnostics and connection health.
Google says its landing page currently excludes subproperties and roll-up properties.
article.why: 量度團隊可較容易查找資料由何處進入，交接時也能更清楚說明連線由誰負責。
article.why_en: Measurement teams can trace data sources and clarify ownership during handoffs.
article.next_step: 先選一個可用的資源，整理連線清單與負責人，再逐項核對診斷。
article.next_step_en: Choose an eligible property and compare diagnostics with an inventory of connections and owners.
article.detail: 這次更新針對資料連線管理。Google把新入口放在管理介面，團隊可據此檢查資料串流及產品連結，並了解哪些項目需要跟進。測試版的使用範圍須以帳戶權限及資源類型確認。若報表出現異常，宜先比對現有設定與事件記錄，再決定是否改動資料來源或廣告匯入方式。
article.detail_en: The update is for managing data connections. Teams can review streams and product links and identify issues needing follow-up. Confirm property type and access before using the beta. For reporting anomalies, check existing setup and event records before changing data sources or ad imports.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
